title: Registry Store Options Schema
description: Generates a signal store (*.store.ts) under src/app/shared/stores.

name.description: The name for the new store.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the store?

project.description: The name of the project where the store should be added.

path.description: The path where the store file should be created, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to src/app/shared/stores.
